title.zh: 卷四十 志第二十一: 樂下 宗廟樂歌 殿庭樂歌 鼓吹導引曲、采茨曲
title.en: Volume 40 Treatises 21: Music 2 - Ancestral Shrine Music and Songs, Palace and Court Music and Songs, Tunes Led by Wind Instruments, Selection of Lyrics and Music
title.raw: 卷四十 志第二十一: 樂下 宗廟樂歌 殿庭樂歌 鼓吹導引曲、采茨曲 Volume 40 Treatises 21: Music 2 - Ancestral Shrine Music and Songs, Palace and Court Music and Songs, Tunes Led by Wind Instruments, Selection of Lyrics and Music

translations.literal: Ancestral shrine music and songs
translations.idiomatic: Music and Songs for the Ancestral Shrine

translations.literal: Di and Xia sacrifices with personal attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Personal attendance at the Di and Xia ancestral sacrifices.

translations.literal: The emperor enters the gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor enters the gate:

translations.literal: Palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace":
translations.idiomatic: Palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace":

translations.literal: (The steps for entering and leaving are the same.)
translations.idiomatic: (The ceremonial steps for entering and leaving are the same.)

translations.literal: Only at this time of rising peace did ritual and ceremony first arise.
translations.idiomatic: In this age of rising peace, ritual and ceremony first took shape.

translations.literal: The sounding bells arrive and halt; solemnly he advances into the court.
translations.idiomatic: Bells ring as he arrives and halts; in solemn grace he enters the courtyard.

translations.literal: The hundred ministers and grand officers reverently and carefully welcome and receive him.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and grand officers in their hundreds receive him with reverent care.

translations.literal: Reverently he presents himself to the ancestors; the spirit hall is thereby at peace.
translations.idiomatic: He reverently pays homage to the ancestors, and the spirit hall finds its rest.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升殿，登歌夾鐘宮《昌甯之曲》：

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the hall; ascent music in Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace":
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor ascends the hall, ascent music in the Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace":

translations.literal: (When ascending the steps and when about to return to the throne seat, all use the same ascent music.)
translations.idiomatic: (The ascent music is the same when he climbs the steps and when he is about to return to the throne seat.)

translations.literal: The sheng and bells are already set out; the jars and goblets stand at the door.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng and bells are arrayed; jars and goblets stand ready at the threshold.

translations.literal: In ascending and descending he has proper bearing; only by rule, only by measure.
translations.idiomatic: His ascent and descent show proper bearing, governed by rule and measure alone.

translations.literal: Reverent and respectful toward the bright spirits; the upper rites are performed in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent before the bright spirits, he performs the high rites in their proper order.

translations.literal: Forever may he preserve it; may he receive Heaven's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: May he preserve it forever and receive Heaven's blessing.

sentences.zh: 皇帝盥洗，宮縣無射宮《昌甯之曲》：惟水之功，潔淨精微。

translations.literal: The emperor washes his hands; palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace": Only water's merit — pure, clean, subtle and refined.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor washes his hands, palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace": By water's power all is made pure, clean, and subtly refined.

translations.literal: He washes the goblets and sets out the jue vessels; in virtue there is splendor.
translations.idiomatic: He rinses the goblets and sets out the sacrificial vessels; virtue itself shines forth.

translations.literal: Majestic and solemn, the awe of the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: Majestic and solemn stands the awe of the ancestral temple.

translations.literal: Fitting that he should move them to descend; blessings and good fortune return together.
translations.idiomatic: Fitting that the spirits should be moved to descend; blessings and good fortune return in turn.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降階，宮縣無射宮《昌甯之曲》：于皇神宮，象天清明。

translations.literal: The emperor descends the steps; palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace": O august spirit hall, mirroring Heaven's clarity and brightness.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor descends the steps, palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Flourishing Peace": O august spirit hall, mirroring Heaven in clarity and light.

translations.literal: Those who come do so in solemn order; the dukes and ministers stand in support.
translations.idiomatic: All who attend come in solemn order, with dukes and ministers standing in support.

translations.literal: Ritual and ceremony are fully completed; the noble man finds his rest therein.
translations.idiomatic: When ritual and ceremony are fully completed, the noble man finds his peace.

translations.literal: Greatly timely, greatly gracious — may our thoughts be brought to fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: So timely, so gracious — may our thoughts be brought to fulfillment.

translations.literal: Welcoming the spirits; palace ensemble, "Tune of Coming Peace":
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the spirits; palace ensemble, "Tune of Coming Peace":

sentences.zh: （黃鐘宮三奏，大呂角二奏，大蔟徵二奏，應鐘羽二奏，詞同）

translations.literal: (Huangzhong mode three performances, Dalü angle two performances, Dacu mode two performances, Yingzhong mode two performances — the lyrics are the same.)
translations.idiomatic: (Three performances in the Huangzhong mode, two in the Dalü angle, two in the Dacu mode, and two in the Yingzhong mode — the lyrics are the same throughout.)

translations.literal: The eight sounds are harmonized; the hundred rites are fully performed.
translations.idiomatic: The eight sounds blend in harmony; the hundred rites are performed in full.

translations.literal: Bright virtue is ever pure; utmost sincerity is forever cherished.
translations.idiomatic: Bright virtue remains ever pure; with utmost sincerity we cherish them forever.

translations.literal: The spirits have come — cloud chariots and wind steeds.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits have descended — borne on cloud chariots and wind steeds.

translations.literal: They come and halt, they come and draw near; for a thousand sacrifices they feast at ease.
translations.idiomatic: They arrive and draw near; for a thousand sacrifices they feast at ease.

sentences.zh: 司徒引俎，宮縣無射宮《豐甯之曲》：維牲維犧，齊明致祠。

translations.literal: The Minister of Works leads in the offering stand; palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Abundant Peace": The victims and sacrificial beasts — with pure mind he conducts the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When the Minister of Works leads in the offering stand, palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Abundant Peace": Victims and sacrificial beasts are brought forth; with a pure mind he conducts the rite.

translations.literal: I shall offer, I shall present — with auspicious purification I present them.
translations.idiomatic: I shall offer and present them, consecrated in auspicious purification.

translations.literal: Broad, large, fat and plump — what the spirits delight in is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Broad, plump, and rich — such offerings are what the spirits delight in.

translations.literal: For a thousand autumns may they savor this; may the black-haired people be forever at peace.
translations.idiomatic: For a thousand years may they savor this offering; may the people be forever at peace.

sentences.zh: 始祖酌獻，宮縣無射宮《大元之曲》：惟酒既清，惟肴既馨。

translations.literal: Pouring the offering to the Founding Ancestor; palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Great Origin": The wine is already clear; the viands are already fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Pouring the offering to the Founding Ancestor, palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Great Origin": The wine is clear, the viands fragrant.

translations.literal: Fragrant is the filial sacrifice, in the courtyard of the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant rises the filial sacrifice in the temple courtyard.

translations.literal: Offerings to the august ancestors — come to feast, come to find peace.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings are set before the august ancestors — come to feast, come and find peace.

translations.literal: Symbolizing merit and displaying virtue — the former ancestors heed this.
translations.idiomatic: Symbolizing their merit and displaying their virtue — may the former ancestors hear.

sentences.zh: 德皇帝，《大熙之曲》：萬方欣戴，鴻業創基。

translations.literal: Emperor De, "Tune of Great Splendor": The ten thousand regions rejoice in bearing him; the great enterprise lays its foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor De, "Tune of Great Splendor": The ten thousand regions rejoice to uphold him; the great enterprise lays its foundation.

translations.literal: The jade source bestows abundance; like trailing melons, glory is renewed again and again.
translations.idiomatic: From the jade spring abundance flows; like trailing melons, glory renews itself again and again.

translations.literal: Thus we exalt the pure sacrifice; thereby we examine and complete the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thus we exalt the pure sacrifice and thereby complete the established regulations.

translations.literal: The platters and stands are arrayed in order; ever more the imperial rites attain perfection.
translations.idiomatic: Platters and stands stand in ordered array; ever more the imperial rites attain their perfection.

sentences.zh: 安皇帝，《大安之曲》：爰圖造邦，載德其昌。

translations.literal: Emperor An, "Tune of Great Peace": Thus he planned the founding of the state; bearing virtue, it flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An, "Tune of Great Peace": He planned the founding of the state; bearing virtue, the realm flourished.

translations.literal: Imperial bearing was truly solemn; auspicious omens gathered at his birth.
translations.idiomatic: His imperial bearing was truly solemn; auspicious omens gathered about him.

translations.literal: Bright sincerity moves the spirits to descend; accumulated depth sends forth flowing light.
translations.idiomatic: Bright sincerity moves the spirits to descend; accumulated virtue sends forth its flowing light.

translations.literal: Reverently solemn is the clear temple; bells and stones ring clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently solemn stands the clear temple; bells and chime-stones ring clear.

sentences.zh: 獻祖，《大昭之曲》：惟聖興邦，經始之初。

translations.literal: Ancestor Xian, "Tune of Great Brightness": Only the sage raises the state — at the very beginning of its founding.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Xian, "Tune of Great Brightness": Only a sage could raise the state — at the very beginning of its founding.

translations.literal: He gathered the people and transformed custom; he restored stability to where they dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered the people and transformed custom, restoring stability to the land where they dwelt.

translations.literal: He advanced in virtue, pure and frugal; his aim and plan looked to distant designs.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced in virtue, pure and frugal, with his aim set on far-reaching designs.

translations.literal: How timely is this illustrious sacrifice; sincerity and truth find response.
translations.idiomatic: How timely is this illustrious sacrifice; sincerity and truth find their response.

sentences.zh: 昭祖，《大成之曲》：天啟璿源，貽慶定基。

translations.literal: Ancestor Zhao, "Tune of Great Accomplishment": Heaven opened the jade source; he bequeathed blessing and fixed the foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Zhao, "Tune of Great Accomplishment": Heaven opened the jade spring; he bequeathed blessing and fixed the foundation.

translations.literal: Leading by righteousness as courage, bestowing virtue as awe.
translations.idiomatic: He led by righteousness as his courage and bestowed virtue as his awe.

translations.literal: Displaying martial prowess he extended the borders; his achievements tower high.
translations.idiomatic: Displaying martial prowess he extended the borders; his achievements tower on high.

translations.literal: May the imperial throne flourish forever; may blessings be shared equally among the black-haired people.
translations.idiomatic: May the imperial throne flourish forever; may blessings be shared equally among all the people.

sentences.zh: 景祖，《大昌之曲》：丕顯鴻烈，基緒降昌。

translations.literal: Ancestor Jing, "Tune of Great Prosperity": Greatly manifest are the grand achievements; the foundation's thread descends in prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Jing, "Tune of Great Prosperity": Greatly manifest are his grand achievements; the foundation's thread descends in prosperity.

translations.literal: The sage's appointed time gathered at his birth; the realm's domain was thereby expanded.
translations.idiomatic: At the sage's appointed time he was born; the realm's domain was thereby expanded.

translations.literal: Reverently solemn is the temple shrine; the spirits descend in bright auspiciousness.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently solemn stands the temple shrine; the spirits descend in bright auspiciousness.

translations.literal: Splendid are the ornate canons; for a hundred million years their light ever increases.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid are the ornate canons; for endless ages their light ever increases.

sentences.zh: 世祖，《大武之曲》：桓桓伐功，天監其明。

translations.literal: Ancestor Shi, "Tune of Great Martiality": Majestic are his campaign achievements; Heaven observes his brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: Ancestor Shi, "Tune of Great Martiality": Majestic are his campaign achievements; Heaven observes his brilliance.

translations.literal: By awe he shook the layered realms; by virtue he brought peace and tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: By awe he shook the layered realms; by virtue he brought peace and tranquility.

translations.literal: Divine stratagems left nothing undone; the great design thereby arose.
translations.idiomatic: Divine stratagems left nothing undone; the great design thereby arose.

translations.literal: The assembled descendants perform filial sacrifice; far and wide his accomplishments shine forth.
translations.idiomatic: His assembled descendants perform filial sacrifice; far and wide his accomplishments shine forth.

sentences.zh: 肅宗，《大明之曲》：于皇神人，武烈文謨。

translations.literal: Emperor Su, "Tune of Great Brightness": O august spirit-man — martial splendor and civil design.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Su, "Tune of Great Brightness": O august spirit among men — martial splendor and civil design.

translations.literal: He assisted the Shizu ancestor, gentle in embrace and sweeping away opposition.
translations.idiomatic: He assisted Ancestor Shi, winning hearts through gentleness and sweeping away all opposition.

translations.literal: His awe shook the far and near; his transforming influence reached even insects and fish.
translations.idiomatic: His awe shook the far and near; his transforming influence reached even to insects and fish.

translations.literal: His radiance extends forever; he fulfilled the founding emperor's trust.
translations.idiomatic: His radiance extends forever; he fulfilled the founding emperor's trust.

sentences.zh: 穆宗，《大章之曲》：烝哉文祖，欽聖弘淵。

translations.literal: Emperor Mu, "Tune of Great Pattern": How abundant is the civil ancestor; he revered the sage and enlarged the deep.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Mu, "Tune of Great Pattern": How abundant is the civil ancestor; he revered the sage and enlarged the realm's depths.

translations.literal: Kindness, love, loyalty, and faith — his canons and records shine forth clearly.
translations.idiomatic: In kindness, love, loyalty, and faith his canons and records shine forth clearly.

translations.literal: May they savor this bright sacrifice; abundant blessings extend without end.
translations.idiomatic: May they savor this bright sacrifice; abundant blessings extend without end.

translations.literal: The age is purely bright; flowing celebration for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: The age is purely bright; may celebration flow for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 康宗，《大康之曲》：惟明惟聽，曄曄神功。

translations.literal: Emperor Kang, "Tune of Great Prosperity": Bright in perception, keen in hearing — resplendent is his divine merit.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Kang, "Tune of Great Prosperity": Bright in perception, keen in hearing — resplendent is his divine merit.

translations.literal: He took as model the work of past ages; the spirits descend to the high vault of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He took as model the work of past ages; the spirits descend to the high vault of Heaven.

translations.literal: The filial descendant who holds fullness offers fragrance in rich abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The filial descendant who holds fullness offers fragrance in rich abundance.

translations.literal: Grant us blessing and good fortune; the imperial transforming influence grows ever higher.
translations.idiomatic: Grant us blessing and good fortune; the imperial transforming influence grows ever higher.

sentences.zh: 太祖，《大定之曲》：功超殷周，德配唐虞。

translations.literal: Taizu, "Tune of Great Settlement": His achievements surpass Yin and Zhou; his virtue matches Tang and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, "Tune of Great Settlement": His achievements surpass Yin and Zhou; his virtue matches Tang and Yu.

translations.literal: Heaven and humanity responded in concert; he pacified and unified the whole realm.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and humanity responded in concert; he pacified and unified the whole realm.

translations.literal: He opened auspiciousness and bestowed abundance; he laid the foundation for an eternal design.
translations.idiomatic: He opened auspiciousness and bestowed abundance; he laid the foundation for an eternal design.

translations.literal: The bright bright Son of Heaven reverently inherits the canons and plans.
translations.idiomatic: The bright Son of Heaven reverently inherits the canons and plans.

sentences.zh: 太宗，《大惠之曲》：巍巍德鴻，無為端扆。

translations.literal: Taizong, "Tune of Great Grace": Towering is his virtue, vast as the wild goose; non-active, he sits at the imperial screen.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, "Tune of Great Grace": Towering is his virtue, vast as the wild goose; in non-action he sits at the imperial screen.

translations.literal: His throne inherited divine merit; he thoroughly tamed custom and perfected beauty.
translations.idiomatic: His throne inherited divine merit; he thoroughly tamed custom and perfected its beauty.

translations.literal: The clear palace gathers brightness; filial and pure, timely sacrifices are performed.
translations.idiomatic: The clear palace gathers brightness; filial and pure, timely sacrifices are performed.

translations.literal: Reverently he sets out offerings in sincere devotion; sacrificial goblets hold fine delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently he sets out offerings in sincere devotion; sacrificial goblets hold fine delicacies.

sentences.zh: 熙宗《大同之曲》：昭顯令德，神基丕承。

translations.literal: Emperor Xi, "Tune of Great Unity": Brightly manifest is his excellent virtue; the divine foundation is greatly inherited.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xi, "Tune of Great Unity": Brightly manifest is his excellent virtue; the divine foundation is greatly inherited.

translations.literal: Facing and responding to Heaven, he presents offerings and ascends in enjoyment.
translations.idiomatic: Facing Heaven in response, he presents offerings and ascends in enjoyment.

translations.literal: How solemn is the clear temple — come to feast, come to find peace.
translations.idiomatic: How solemn is the clear temple — come to feast, come and find peace.

translations.literal: May the spirits be well pleased and halt; only reverence and fulfilled sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: May the spirits be well pleased; only reverence and fulfilled sincerity.

sentences.zh: 睿宗，《大和之曲》：皇祖開基，周武殷湯。

translations.literal: Emperor Rui, "Tune of Great Harmony": The imperial ancestor opened the foundation — like King Wu of Zhou and King Tang of Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Rui, "Tune of Great Harmony": The imperial ancestor opened the foundation — like King Wu of Zhou and King Tang of Yin.

translations.literal: Ah, the sage father — the inherited virtue ever increases in radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Ah, the sage father — the inherited virtue ever increases in radiance.

translations.literal: He opened and blessed the great succession; long may auspiciousness flourish.
translations.idiomatic: He opened and blessed the great succession; long may auspiciousness flourish.

translations.literal: Solemn and reverent is the temple offering; for ten thousand generations the seasonal sacrifices continue.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and reverent is the temple offering; for ten thousand generations the seasonal sacrifices continue.

sentences.zh: 世宗，《大鈞之曲》：神之來思，甫登於堂。

translations.literal: Emperor Shi, "Tune of Great Balance": The spirits have come — just now ascending the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shi, "Tune of Great Balance": The spirits have come — just now ascending the hall.

translations.literal: The grain offerings and jade tablets have their libation vessels; the black millet ale is fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings and jade tablets stand with their libation vessels; black millet ale is fragrant.

translations.literal: Towering are the former achievements; they open blessing without limit.
translations.idiomatic: Towering are the former achievements; they open blessing without limit.

translations.literal: For ten thousand years the seasonal sacrifices continue; filial hearts do not forget.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years the seasonal sacrifices continue; filial hearts do not forget.

sentences.zh: 顯宗，《大寧之曲》：于皇神宮，有嚴惟清。

translations.literal: Emperor Xian, "Tune of Great Tranquility": O august spirit hall — solemn in bearing, pure alone.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xian, "Tune of Great Tranquility": O august spirit hall — solemn in bearing, pure alone.

translations.literal: With auspicious purification the filial sacrifice is performed; only the spirits' tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: With auspicious purification the filial sacrifice is performed; may the spirits find their peace.

translations.literal: Facing and responding to Heaven, may our sincere thoughts be brought to fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Facing Heaven in response, may our sincere thoughts be brought to fulfillment.

translations.literal: Spread blessing for a hundred million years — the celebration of state and clan.
translations.idiomatic: Spread blessing for endless ages — the celebration of state and clan.

sentences.zh: 章宗，《大隆之典》：兩紀踐阼，萬方甯康。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhang, "Canon of Great Eminence": Two reign cycles on the throne; the ten thousand regions are at peace and well.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhang, "Canon of Great Eminence": Two reign cycles on the throne; the ten thousand regions are at peace and well.

translations.literal: In civil affairs he spans Heaven and Earth; in martial affairs he subdues the distant wilds.
translations.idiomatic: In civil affairs he spans Heaven and Earth; in martial affairs he subdues the distant wilds.

translations.literal: Ritual is complete and regulations established; virtue is lofty and the enterprise flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual is complete and regulations established; virtue is lofty and the enterprise flourishes.

translations.literal: Dwelling in enjoyment of the canonical sacrifice; for a hundred million years without limit.
translations.idiomatic: May they dwell in enjoyment of the canonical sacrifice; for endless ages without limit.

sentences.zh: 宣宗，《大慶之曲》：猗歟聖皇，三代之英。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan, "Tune of Great Celebration": Ah, the sage emperor — a hero of the Three Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan, "Tune of Great Celebration": Ah, the sage emperor — a hero of the Three Dynasties.

translations.literal: His achievements shine before and after; his virtue covers all living beings.
translations.idiomatic: His achievements shine before and after; his virtue covers all living beings.

translations.literal: The victims and grain offerings are fragrant alone; drums and bells ring clearly.
translations.idiomatic: Victims and grain offerings are fragrant; drums and bells ring clear.

translations.literal: O spirits, you have come — may you savor our fulfilled sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: O spirits, you have come — may you savor our fulfilled sincerity.

sentences.zh: 文舞退，武舞進，宮縣無射宮《肅甯之曲》：明明先皇，神武維揚。

translations.literal: The civil dance withdraws, the martial dance advances; palace ensemble, Wuyi mode, "Tune of Solemn Peace": Bright bright is the former emperor; divine martial prowess is displayed.
translations.idiomatic: The civil dance withdraws and the martial dance advances; palace ensemble in the Wuyi mode, "Tune of Solemn Peace": Bright bright is the former emperor; divine martial prowess is displayed.

translations.literal: He opened the foundation and handed down the succession; for ten thousand generations without limit.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the foundation and handed down the succession; for ten thousand generations without limit.

translations.literal: Shield and axe symbolize his achievements; majesty and bearing have radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Shield and axe symbolize his achievements; majesty and bearing shine with radiance.

translations.literal: The spirits are thereby feasted; brightly they bestow peace and well-being.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are thereby feasted; brightly they bestow peace and well-being.

sentences.zh: 亞終獻，無射宮《肅甯之曲》：涓辰之休，昭祀惟恭。

translations.literal: The penultimate and final offerings; Wuyi mode, "Tune of Solemn Peace": The chosen day's blessing — the bright sacrifice is reverent alone.
translations.idiomatic: The penultimate and final offerings; Wuyi mode, "Tune of Solemn Peace": On the chosen day's blessing — the bright sacrifice is reverent alone.

translations.literal: Majestic bearing in ascending and descending — only ritual is followed.
translations.idiomatic: Majestic bearing in ascending and descending — only ritual is followed.

translations.literal: The platters and stands are quietly fine; harmonious are the drums and bells.
translations.idiomatic: Platters and stands stand quietly fine; harmonious are the drums and bells.

translations.literal: Only the emperor receives blessing; he observes this virtuous bearing.
translations.idiomatic: May the emperor receive blessing as he observes this virtuous bearing.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲福，登歌夾鐘宮《福甯之曲》：犧牲充潔，粢盛馨香。

translations.literal: The emperor drinks the blessing; ascent music in Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Blessing and Peace": The sacrificial victims are full and pure; the grain offerings are fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor drinks the blessing, ascent music in the Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Blessing and Peace": Sacrificial victims are full and pure; grain offerings are fragrant.

translations.literal: They come and descend, they come and enjoy — the spiritual essence is thereby displayed.
translations.idiomatic: They come and descend, they come and enjoy — the spiritual essence is thereby displayed.

translations.literal: Drinking this pure blessing — simple and abundant, rich and full.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking this pure blessing — simple and abundant, rich and full.

translations.literal: The civil and bright Son of Heaven — ten thousand years of life without limit.
translations.idiomatic: The civil and bright Son of Heaven — ten thousand years of life without limit.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，登歌夾鐘宮《豐甯之曲》：孝祀肅睦，明德以薦。

translations.literal: Removing the offerings; ascent music in Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Abundant Peace": The filial sacrifice is solemn and harmonious; bright virtue is thereby presented.
translations.idiomatic: When the offerings are removed, ascent music in the Jiazhong mode, "Tune of Abundant Peace": The filial sacrifice is solemn and harmonious; bright virtue is thereby presented.

translations.literal: Music is performed to the ninefold completion; ritual ends with the three offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Music is performed to the ninefold completion; ritual ends with the three offerings.

translations.literal: The hundred ministers and grand officers advance the removal in timely order.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers and grand officers in their hundreds advance the removal in timely order.

translations.literal: Young and old bow to the ground; the spirits are thereby sent on their return.
translations.idiomatic: Young and old bow to the ground; the spirits are thereby sent on their return.

sentences.zh: 送神，宮縣黃鐘宮《來甯之曲》：潔茲牛羊，清茲酒醴。

translations.literal: Sending off the spirits; palace ensemble, Huangzhong mode, "Tune of Coming Peace": Pure are these cattle and sheep; clear is this wine and ale.

translations.idiomatic: Responding in praise to the great blessing; divining years for a hundred million.

translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince enters the gate, performed, "Tune of Solemn Peace": Light illumines the Fore Star; only Heaven hangs forth the image.

translations.literal: Examining antiquity in action; lord of the vessel for long duration.
translations.idiomatic: Examining antiquity in action; lord of the vessel for long duration.

translations.literal: The detailed rites announce completion; near and far look to him.
translations.idiomatic: The detailed rites announce completion; near and far look to him.

translations.literal: The state's foundation is already lofty; abundant blessing enjoyed forever.
translations.idiomatic: The state's foundation is already lofty; abundant blessing enjoyed forever.

translations.literal: The host of ministers form ranks together; performed, "Tune of Fine Peace": O august at the throne; rites honor the heir; the blessing of Heaven's favor — adhering to correctness in proper position.
translations.idiomatic: The host of ministers form ranks together; performed, "Tune of Fine Peace": O august at the throne; rites honor the heir; the blessing of Heaven's favor — adhering to correctness in proper position.

translations.literal: Speaking of viewing his bearing — soaring and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking of viewing his bearing — soaring and abundant.

translations.literal: Beauty returns to our lord; Great Peace — ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Beauty returns to our lord; Great Peace — ten thousand years.

translations.literal: The crown prince again receives the investiture; performed, "Tune of Harmonious Peace": Ancestral achievements were arduous; he managed and founded the structure.
translations.idiomatic: When the crown prince again receives the investiture, performed, "Tune of Harmonious Peace": Ancestral achievements were arduous; he managed and founded the structure.

translations.idiomatic: Brightly he bequeaths his plans; paired blessings gather as protection.

translations.literal: The heir is thereby upright; long life to our emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The heir is thereby upright; long life to our emperor.

translations.literal: May our state's foundation rise high; without limit, only celebration.
translations.idiomatic: May our state's foundation rise high; without limit, only celebration.

translations.idiomatic: Grandson's plans are bequeathed; celebratory order brightly extends.

translations.literal: The host of ministers form ranks together; performed, "Tune of Compliant Peace": The tassels face the throne; emblems and banners are fully raised.
translations.idiomatic: The host of ministers form ranks together; performed, "Tune of Compliant Peace": The tassels face the throne; emblems and banners are fully raised.

translations.idiomatic: Colored halberds fill the courtyard; bells and chime-stones line the racks; abundant are the many officers; wing-like they take their places.

translations.idiomatic: Golden halberds and jade axes attend the incense fires; on the imperial roadway the six dragons move at ease.

translations.idiomatic: Songs everywhere are much the same — long life to the Son of Heaven, like the southern mountain.

translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven in Great Peace receives much blessing; filial virtue joins with Heaven.

translations.idiomatic: Phoenix flutes and dragon pipes perform the Shao music; the sound is within the five clouds.

translations.idiomatic: Splendid are the cultural artifacts, displaying the age of order; endless sacrifices without end.

translations.idiomatic: The age's fortune harmonizes for a thousand spans; the five planetary markers link with the stars.

translations.idiomatic: The six dragons receive the dawn sun; the vermilion phoenix leans on mid-Heaven.

translations.literal: Royal qi coils around mountains and seas; the imperial dwelling for a hundred million years.
translations.idiomatic: Royal qi coils around mountains and seas; the imperial dwelling for endless ages.

translations.idiomatic: Great Peace raises ornate rites; the ten thousand states gain joyful hearts.

translations.idiomatic: Filial piety moves them to welcome distant blessing; abundant blessing forever descends.

translations.idiomatic: The six dragons come from Heaven; the imperial roadway is level as if swept.

translations.idiomatic: The six dragons turn the reins; a thousand officials guard; jade sounding-stones, pendant rings in the wind.
